bosses.name: Lady Sarevess
bosses.general: Naga with two guards: Forked Lightning in front of her, Frost Nova and Slow.
bosses.tank: Face her away from the group; grab her guards.
bosses.healer: Dispel the Slow and Frost Nova, heal the lightning.
bosses.dps: Stay out of her front; guards first if they're loose.

bosses.name: Gelihast
bosses.general: Murloc boss: nets players in place and has murloc friends.
bosses.healer: Dispel the net if you can.

bosses.name: Lorgus Jett
bosses.general: Twilight shaman: Lightning Bolt, Lightning Shield and Healing Wave.
bosses.dps: Interrupt his Healing Wave; purge his shield.

bosses.name: Baron Aquanis
bosses.general: Called by the Fathom Stone: Frostbolts.

bosses.name: Twilight Lord Kelris
bosses.general: Mind Blast and Sleep. Clear his room's cultists first.

bosses.name: Old Serra'kis
bosses.general: Big shark under water: Thrash. Watch your breath.
bosses.tank: Hold it near an air pocket if you can.
bosses.healer: Heal through Thrash, mind your breath.

bosses.name: Aku'mai
bosses.general: Lighting the four braziers calls waves of turtles and murlocs; then Aku'mai. Poison Clouds and she goes frenzied at low health.
bosses.tank: Tank her against the wall, keep her out of the clouds.
bosses.healer: Save mana for the last third, she hits much harder then.
bosses.dps: Step out of the green clouds; burn her in the frenzy.
